CNCF's KubeCon North America 2026 Opens in Salt Lake City: Why Kubernetes Cannot Tell Which AI Agent Took Action

KubeCon North America 2026 opens November 9-12 in Salt Lake City. CNCF's conference confronts Kubernetes' AI identity gap: AI agents sharing a service account get one cryptographic credential, making attribution impossible when agents act. Sessions address llm-d 1.0, the Gateway API Inference Extens
